parallel.requirements: The parent and implementer recognized the required std-only Rust 2021 port, root test18.rs, Cargo project, default count 18, --a parsing, exact output, f32 0.9 reserve formula, size=count, and overflow_size=0 behavior.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent first probed the reference binary, then split the remaining work into an implementation child and an independent reference-table child, while retaining final integration and acceptance checking.
parallel.implementation: Agent-0 wrote Cargo.toml, src/lib.rs, src/hopscotch_map.rs, test18.rs, and src/main.rs using the supplied formula, a Vec of bucket slots plus overflow Vec, identity hash, 62-bucket probing, and growth logic.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Agent-0 owned /output deliverables, agent-1 wrote only /tmp reference artifacts, and the parent consumed both child results before confirming /output contained Cargo.lock, Cargo.toml, src, target, test18, and test18.rs.
parallel.verification: Agent-0 built with rustc and cargo and compared 61 cases; agent-1 independently verified 288 count rows plus noargs; the parent then ran a 289-row table check with zero mismatches, followed by official 39/39 success.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: No unresolved implementation, integration, or delivery defect is evidenced at closure; minor missing file/python/grep tools were recovered and did not affect the final artifact.

serial.requirements: The serial agent recognized the same Rust porting, CLI, exact-output, std-only, black-box, and project-layout obligations, and further checked negative and invalid-argument behavior while probing.
serial.plan_and_ownership: A single main agent owned probing, implementation, build repair, formula correction, integration, final verification, and reporting without delegation or child handoffs.
serial.implementation: The serial agent wrote src/hopscotch_map.rs, test18.rs, and Cargo.toml, fixed a missing BuildHasher import, removed unused code, and replaced an initially wrong strict-power-of-two rule with the 0.9 load-factor reserve/growth behavior.
serial.integration_and_delivery: All edits were local to the one serial actor, producing the root test18.rs binary and Cargo target artifacts without cross-agent reconciliation or shared-write ambiguity.
serial.verification: The serial agent ran targeted C++ probes, compiled with rustc and cargo, found mismatches in a differential sweep, patched the implementation, reran a broader sweep to ALL MATCH, spot-checked cargo release output, and official evaluation passed 39/39.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: No unresolved defect remains in the completed serial artifact; earlier compile and formula errors were detected and fixed before final response.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel preserved the prompt's exact requirements and passed the derived f32 0.9 formula into the implementation child before coding.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial worked from the same prompt and independently inferred requirements through probes, correcting its early strict-power-of-two hypothesis before closure.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both covered the required behavior; parallel front-loaded the exact formula before delegation, while serial discovered and repaired the same point during its own verification loop.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used two subagents with distinct scopes: agent-0 implemented the project and agent-1 generated an independent reference table, with the parent owning final cross-checking.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used no subagents; the main actor owned probing, coding, fixing, and verification end to end.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The parallel plan distributed implementation and oracle generation but retained parent-level assembly/verification; the serial plan was slower but avoided delegation boundaries entirely.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The implementation child received the exact formula, required files, build modes, and verification targets, while the reference child had a read-only /tmp-table task.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no cross-agent interface; the same agent carried its probe results into file edits and later corrections.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel introduced handoff boundaries but the briefs were sufficient and the returned results were usable; serial kept all context in one trajectory.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Agent-0 directly wrote a simple std-only HopscotchMap and mirrored entry logic in root test18.rs and src/main.rs, then built successfully.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote a more elaborate implementation, hit a compile error, fixed imports, then corrected reserve and insert-growth behavior after test mismatches.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel reached a correct implementation through delegated work using a parent-provided formula; serial reached correctness through iterative single-agent debugging.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Both subagents completed and their handoffs reached the parent; the parent consumed those results before the final check.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child result lifecycle; local edits and tool results stayed within the main actor's control.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had successful child completion/reception without unjoined work, while serial avoided child lifecycle risks by remaining single-agent.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Agent-0 produced the /output project while agent-1 limited writes to /tmp reference artifacts, and the parent listed the final /output tree after verification.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial directly edited the final /output files in one actor and listed a coherent final tree after verification.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had no observed shared-state conflict because write ownership was separated; serial had no cross-agent state sharing at all.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel had child-level build and 61-case verification, an independent 289-row oracle, parent-level 289-row recheck, and official 39/39 evaluation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial compiled, detected mismatches, patched the implementation, reran a broad differential sweep to ALL MATCH, checked cargo release outputs, and official evaluation passed 39/39.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both had evaluator-aligned differential verification before official acceptance; parallel added independent oracle generation, while serial used iterative self-correction.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel completed in 537.834 agent seconds and 568.539 cell seconds with no timeout, after the two-child swarm and final parent check.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial completed in 872.837 agent seconds and 905.475 cell seconds with no timeout, after more local probing and correction cycles.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel used delegation to shorten elapsed work while still closing normally; neither run left unfinished work or hit the official timeout.

outcome_analysis.explanation: Both current completed official evaluations passed 39 of 39 cases. The parallel solution differed mainly in coordination: parent probing supplied a correct formula to an implementation child while a second child produced an independent reference table, and the parent consumed both before final verification. The serial solution kept all work in one actor, initially made a wrong bucket-count inference, caught it with differential testing, corrected the formula, and also passed.
parallel_contributors: Parent derived the f32 0.9 load-factor formula before delegation and provided it to the implementer.
Implementation and independent reference generation ran as separate child scopes and were both joined before final parent verification.
serial_contributors: Single actor retained all probe, code, fix, and verification state in one trajectory.
Differential testing exposed the initially wrong strict-next-power-of-two rule and drove the later correction.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial had a temporary missing BuildHasher import and an incorrect reserve/growth hypothesis, both fixed before closure.
Parallel agent-0 implemented from the parent-supplied formula without the same correction cycle.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; comparative differences are strategy-level rather than retained adverse coordination patterns
